# APILAB — Viktor Zakharov Portfolio

> Personal portfolio of Viktor Zakharov, a lead frontend developer with more than 12 years of commercial software development experience.

The website is available in Russian and English. It presents Viktor's professional background, technical skills, work experience, and selected projects. Section fragments point to content on the same single-page portfolio.

## Main pages

- [Russian portfolio](https://apilab.ru/): Main version of the portfolio in Russian.
- [English portfolio](https://apilab.ru/en/): English version of the portfolio.

## Portfolio sections

- [About](https://apilab.ru/#intro): Professional summary and contact links.
- [Skills](https://apilab.ru/#skills): Frontend, backend, tooling, and infrastructure skills.
- [Experience](https://apilab.ru/#experience): Commercial work experience and roles.
- [Projects](https://apilab.ru/#projects): Selected software projects with descriptions and technology stacks.

## Profiles

- [GitHub](https://github.com/apilab-ru/): Public source-code repositories.
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/apilab/): Professional profile.
- [Telegram](https://t.me/apilab): Contact Viktor Zakharov.
